## 目标

StorageOwned and StorageShared trait definitions

按照 `build/SUMMARY.md` 中 W7T5 的定义，在 `src/storage/mod.rs` 中完成此 task 的最小实现，并保持与 `docs/design/05-storage.md` §5（公共 API）、§6（实现细节）、§7（错误/安全约束）和 §8（测试计划）一致。

## 前置准备

- 完成前置任务：W7T4
- 确认 `error` 与 `private::Sealed` 基础设施可用

## 实施步骤

### Step 1: Define owned and shared traits

Add owned mutable storage constructors/conversion methods and the shared read-only marker trait. These traits define capability boundaries but no runtime branching.

```rust
pub unsafe trait StorageOwned: StorageMut + Clone + crate::private::Sealed {
    fn zeros(len: usize) -> Self
    where
        Self::Elem: Default;

    fn from_elem(len: usize, value: Self::Elem) -> Self
    where
        Self::Elem: Clone;

    fn from_vec(vec: Vec<Self::Elem>) -> Result<Self, crate::error::XenonError>
    where
        Self::Elem: Copy;

    fn from_iter<I: IntoIterator<Item = Self::Elem>>(iter: I) -> Self;

    fn into_vec(self) -> Vec<Self::Elem>;

    fn deep_clone(&self) -> Self;

    fn capacity(&self) -> usize;

    fn try_reserve(&mut self, new_capacity: usize) -> Result<(), crate::error::XenonError>;
}

pub unsafe trait StorageShared: Storage + Clone + crate::private::Sealed {}
```
### Step 2: 单元测试

> **强制要求**:
> - 本步骤必须包含一个或者多个单元测试。
> - 测试函数名称和测试内容必须参考对应设计文档的 **「测试计划」** 一节。
> - 编译检查与Lint检查不等同于单元测试。
> - 如果测试没有通过需要修复直至测试通过。
> - **无测试 = 任务未完成。**

参考 `docs/design/05-storage.md` 的「测试计划」为本 task 增加以下测试：

```rust
#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[derive(Clone)]
    struct MockOwned {
        data: Vec<i32>,
    }

    #[derive(Clone)]
    struct MockShared {
        data: Vec<i32>,
    }

    impl crate::private::Sealed for MockOwned {}
    impl crate::private::Sealed for MockShared {}

    unsafe impl RawStorage for MockOwned {
        type Elem = i32;

        fn as_ptr(&self) -> *const Self::Elem {
            self.data.as_ptr()
        }

        fn len(&self) -> usize {
            self.data.len()
        }
    }

    unsafe impl RawStorageMut for MockOwned {
        fn as_mut_ptr(&mut self) -> *mut Self::Elem {
            self.data.as_mut_ptr()
        }
    }

    unsafe impl Storage for MockOwned {}
    unsafe impl StorageMut for MockOwned {}

    unsafe impl StorageOwned for MockOwned {
        fn zeros(len: usize) -> Self
        where
            Self::Elem: Default,
        {
            Self { data: vec![Self::Elem::default(); len] }
        }

        fn from_elem(len: usize, value: Self::Elem) -> Self
        where
            Self::Elem: Clone,
        {
            Self { data: vec![value; len] }
        }

        fn from_vec(vec: Vec<Self::Elem>) -> Result<Self, crate::error::XenonError>
        where
            Self::Elem: Copy,
        {
            Ok(Self { data: vec })
        }

        fn from_iter<I: IntoIterator<Item = Self::Elem>>(iter: I) -> Self {
            Self { data: iter.into_iter().collect() }
        }

        fn into_vec(self) -> Vec<Self::Elem> {
            self.data
        }

        fn deep_clone(&self) -> Self {
            self.clone()
        }

        fn capacity(&self) -> usize {
            self.data.capacity()
        }

        fn try_reserve(&mut self, new_capacity: usize) -> Result<(), crate::error::XenonError> {
            if new_capacity > self.capacity() {
                self.data.reserve(new_capacity - self.capacity());
            }
            Ok(())
        }
    }

    unsafe impl RawStorage for MockShared {
        type Elem = i32;

        fn as_ptr(&self) -> *const Self::Elem {
            self.data.as_ptr()
        }

        fn len(&self) -> usize {
            self.data.len()
        }
    }

    unsafe impl Storage for MockShared {}
    unsafe impl StorageShared for MockShared {}

    fn assert_storage_owned<S: StorageOwned>() {}
    fn assert_storage_shared<S: StorageShared>() {}

    #[test]
    fn test_storage_traits_compile() {
        assert_storage_owned::<MockOwned>();
        assert_storage_shared::<MockShared>();
    }
}
```

## 关键设计决策

| 决策 | 依据 |
|------|------|
| 存储能力通过 trait 层次表达 | `05-storage §5.2` 定义 `RawStorage -> Storage -> StorageMut -> StorageOwned` |
| `StorageOwned::from_vec` 保持 fallible | `05-storage §5.7` 定义返回 `Result<Self, XenonError>`，用于保留对齐分配失败路径 |
| `StorageShared` 仅作为 sealed read-only marker | `05-storage §5.8` 定义 `StorageShared: Storage + Clone + crate::private::Sealed`，引用计数 helper 不进入公开 trait |
| Owned 使用内部对齐缓冲而非裸 Vec | `05-storage §6.2` 要求 64 字节对齐并避免错误 dealloc 布局 |
| `ArcRepr` 公开只读 | `05-storage §5.1` 与 §6.7 明确共享可写不属于 storage 公共 API |

## 验证方式

1. 编译检查: `cargo check`
2. Lint 检查: `cargo clippy --all-targets`
3. 测试验证: `cargo test storage`
4. 手动验证: 构造 `Owned -> ViewRepr -> ArcRepr` 的最小路径，检查内容、长度和对齐查询。

## 注意事项

- ZST 与空数组不能触发未定义行为，也不能错误调用 dealloc。
- `StorageOwned::try_reserve` 的参数是目标总容量 `new_capacity`，不是 additional capacity；见 `05-storage §5.7`。
- `into_shared(self) -> ArcRepr<A>` 不属于 `StorageOwned` trait；它是 W7T12 在 `Owned<A>` 上实现的 inherent method。
- `ViewMutRepr` 不允许实现 `Clone` 或 `Copy`。
- `tests/test_storage.rs` 明确禁止新增；集成覆盖应放入现有 tensor/index/ffi/iterator 测试文件或模块内测试。
